A project I discovered a few weeks ago. Here's an answer to some questions based on some reading and testing the stuff. Technical details are considered from a beginner's perspective.

What is it?

A social experiment to create an entirely decentralized and scalable structure driven solely by the community. The idea is that if a group with shared values is given a substantial decision they will make the right choice. To that end, the projects uses the protocol of the Führerprocess.

Go on

An organization's structure affects its output (onway's Law) and adding more staff will only speed up matters till the point where a decision has to be made (Amdahl's Law). Hence, the proposed solution is to remove the need for centralization or upfront consensus. The premise behind the project is that this - i.e. what's described above is the only method of creating a truly scalable project.

Sounds nice. But is this a pump-and-dump scheme / honeypot?

First of all, you can't buy the coin. Aside from a brief period (hours, IIRC) where it was somehow listed on an exchange, the only way of obtaining is it through mining. The algorithm used currently is CryptoNight, same as Monero. Further optimizations have made it so that phone mining is actually the most efficient relative to overall power consumption. The original manifesto also warned participants not to waste money on a experiment.

Adolfcoin also has a very slow emission rate of ~1000 years) for all coins to be released. There are no pre-mined coins, no instamine, no ICOs, etc.... For several months during development, the coin underwent several 42-day purges where the blockchain was reset every 30k blocks or so, after some miner tried to overwhelm the network with hash power (the 'Great Hash War' of '17).

All in all, even in the hypothetical scenario that it is a pump-and-dump scheme, the project is fairly developed and extensive. There's a forum along with plans for artwork, merchandise, and a marketplace.

Ultimately, it's up to you to decide whether the project is worth investing time in.

How do I get set up?

https://gitlab.com/Adolfcoin/Vergeltung/raw/binaries/Vergeltung-win32.zip - Windows binaries
https://gitlab.com/Adolfcoin/Vergeltung - Compiling for Linux

As with Voat, there are a known bug: the re-import bug. If you create a wallet and start mining, coins don't show up until after you restored your wallet with a 25-word mnemonic key ("seed").

You can also mine via a mining pool. This method generally produces more consistent and frequent rewards than mining raw dog (a standalone node).

One simple miner is xmr-stak: https://github.com/fireice-uk/xmr-stak/releases. Other Monero miners should work with an adolf wallet and the correct pool configuration.

To create a wallet run adolf-wallet-cli or adolf-wallet-gui and you will see a prompt.

What can I do with my coins?

As stated above, several measures have been take to reduce the value of the coin for mere profiteers. But one related project that will be launching soon is Adolf's Anonymous Market

Adolf’s Anonymous Marketplace is an experiment in providing normal people an easy, safe and cheap way to buy or sell products/services with a level of privacy that they decide and without the need to use complicated software.

Please see the roadmap for an estimated timeline of when Adolf’s Anonymous Market will be open.
